duplicate_policy: Exclude entire detected families overlapping any prior audited data; exclude contradictory identical-pixel families; retain one per decoded pixel hash; group pHash<=4 + SSIM>=.97 near matches for uncertainty.
label_policy: Publisher original-image categories retained. No model inference has occurred during selection/audit.
limitations: Publisher labels are not independently diagnosed here. Similarity checks may miss crops, alternate views and garden/session relationships. Group intervals do not capture those missing relationships.

additional_geometric_audit.purpose: Classical, nonlearned duplicate detection only; not CNN features or training.
additional_geometric_audit.shortlists: For each candidate: top 20 other new-image pHashes within Hamming 26; then top 12 distinct prior-image pHashes within Hamming 26 for retained family representatives.
additional_geometric_audit.confirmation: L2 Lowe ratio .7; at least 20 homography RANSAC inliers (3px) and >=.7 inlier ratio; convex hull >=.04 area in both; aligned grayscale correlation >=.90 over >=1000 pixels.
additional_geometric_audit.policy: Propagate prior overlap across confirmed photo families. Exclude contradictory binary labels in a family. Keep one representative per remaining photo family. Frozen before any CNN predictions.
additional_geometric_audit.limitation: Shortlisting is incomplete and geometric checks can miss heavily transformed copies or different views. Does not prove garden/session independence.
